prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1018; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision described in the enclosed claim materials. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage policy limits applicable to the insured driver involved in this incident, along with a copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the accident. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage may apply.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics, adjuster notes, recorded statements, claim file materials, repair estimates, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Routine deletion or disposal of such materials should be suspended until this claim is fully resolved.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing within fourteen days.
